product.name: Career Advisory Session
product.description: A one-hour individual consultation to address specific career or educational questions such as resume review, LinkedIn profile, or career decision-making.

product.name: Graduate Package
product.description: A service package for recent university graduates including resume preparation, interview readiness, and a report on suitable job opportunities.

product.name: Launch Package
product.description: A service package for high school graduates focusing on selecting an appropriate university major, building an academic plan, and providing a detailed report on suitable specializations.

product.name: Flawless Career Assessment
product.description: A psychometric career assessment tool that identifies personal strengths, personality type, and suggests suitable career paths based on scientific criteria.
